The complete three-round original/attention-candidate comparison at actual 14/22-GB ceilings passes all twelve physical watchdogs, natural-task completion checks and frozen pilot timing rules. Plain attention removes much of the smaller pack's earlier generation penalty, but is not a broad win over the original.
